definitions.explanation: The latter part of summer, roughly from mid-August into early September. A somewhat literary term that evokes the waning of summer's heat and the approaching autumn.

examples.japanese: {晩夏|ばんか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日差|ひざ}し→日差し：00107_hizashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: The late summer sun is still strong.

examples.japanese: {晩夏|ばんか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{蝉|せみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{変|か}わって→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧くる。
examples.english: As late summer arrives, the sound of the cicadas gradually changes.

examples.japanese: {晩夏|ばんか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夕暮|ゆうぐ}れ→夕暮れ：07682_yuugure⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦どこか→どこか：02361_dokoka⟧{寂|さび}しさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: There's a certain loneliness in the late summer twilight.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{晩|ばん}→晩：00542_ban⟧ (late/evening) and {夏|か} (summer). The ⟦{晩|ばん}→晩：00542_ban⟧ prefix is used with other seasons as well to indicate the latter part of that season. Has a literary, slightly melancholic quality, often associated with the bittersweet feeling of summer ending.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {晩夏|ばんか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{候|こう}: the late summer season (used in formal letters)
- {晩夏|ばんか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧: late summer sky
- {晩夏|ばんか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧: late summer light

SEASONAL TERMS:
The ⟦{晩|ばん}→晩：00542_ban⟧〜 pattern applies to all seasons:
- ⟦{晩春|ばんしゅん}→晩春：13093_banshun⟧: late spring
- {晩夏|ばんか}: late summer
- ⟦{晩秋|ばんしゅう}→晩秋：08561_banshuu⟧: late autumn
- {晩冬|ばんとう}: late winter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{盛夏|せいか}→盛夏：19161_seika⟧: midsummer, height of summer — the hottest part of summer, roughly July to mid-August
- ⟦{初夏|しょか}→初夏：11740_shoka⟧: early summer — the beginning of summer, around May to June
- ⟦{残暑|ざんしょ}→残暑：08559_zansho⟧: lingering summer heat — specifically the heat that continues after the traditional end of summer (⟦{立秋|りっしゅう}→立秋：26285_risshuu⟧)
